categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and updates CMake compiler checks, CI configs, and minimum compiler requirements.
categories.rationale: Bumping minimum Clang to version 19 allows dropping compiler bug workarounds and enables C++20 CTAD for alias templates across the codebase. As noted in the description, most supported OSes ship clang-19 or later, making this a routine compiler baseline upgrade.

categories.evidence: Doc changes in doc/dependencies.md and doc/build-osx.md merely follow directly from the build system compiler bump.
categories.rationale: Documentation updates are incidental to the build system change.
